title: EXPLORING THE NORTH OF THE RED RIVER
summary: We continue riding through small alley roads in the middle of the rice paddies, enjoying an exciting off-road adventure. We will make some stops for you to learn how rice is grown and understand more about wet rice cultivation.
inclusions: All entrance fees & cold water throughout the tour
html:
ITINERARY

  • Vietlook Travel will drive you across the spectacular Long Bien Bridge that spans the Red River. We then ride our scooters along the riverbank toward the countryside, where you will see vast green rice paddies and rural villages hidden alongside the fields.
  • We continue riding through small alley roads in the middle of the rice paddies, enjoying an exciting off-road adventure. We will make some stops for you to learn how rice is grown and understand more about wet rice cultivation.
  • Back on the scooter, our authentic riders will take you to visit a 900 year old village that still preserves its ancient architecture. Here, you will learn about traditional culture and village life.
  • We then head to a local market to see how people buy and sell their daily essentials. You will also have the chance to try tropical fruits.
  • Next, we ride to visit the temple worshipping King An Duong Vuong. This ancient site dates back to 257 BC and was once the capital of Vietnam, known as Co Loa Citadel. It is the perfect place to learn about the history of Hanoi and Vietnam.
  • After visiting Co Loa Citadel, we take you to a local coffee shop to enjoy Vietnamese coffee and you can also try Hanoi’s famous Egg Coffee.
  • We then hop back on the scooter and head to a local restaurant for you to enjoy authentic Vietnamese cuisine. After lunch, our rider team will take you back to your hotel or drop you off anywhere you prefer. Just let us know. Goodbye.

INCLUDED

  • Scooter, fuel, helmet

  • Experienced professional riders

  • English-speaking guides

  • Lunch at a local restaurant

  • All entrance fees & cold water throughout the tour

  • Free pick-up and drop-off

  • Raincoat (if needed)
outline: Day 1: EXPLORING THE NORTH OF THE RED RIVER
